target_title: Principal AI Engineer / AI Solutions Architect
summary: Principal AI Engineer and Technical Leader with over 20 years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise AI and operational intelligence systems that enable actionable decision support and reliability insights.
Proven expertise in production AI systems, including RAG, agentic AI, tool orchestration, and graph-based dependency modeling, with hands-on experience on BigQuery, GCP, AWS, and Python.

Deep background in observability, monitoring, AI governance, and operational intelligence, with a strong record of translating complex business challenges into governed, measurable AI architectures and roadmaps.

Cross-industry experience spanning utilities, financial services, media, retail, telecommunications, and aerospace/defense, with a patent for deployed real-time decision systems and recognized leadership in AI education.

professional_experience.heading: Principal Consultant
bullets: Led analytical readiness assessment for Oracle/EBS and Maximo data migrated to BigQuery, establishing a foundation for cross-domain enterprise analytics integrating construction operations and financial systems.

Developed automated frameworks for profiling, type inference, duplicate detection, candidate key analysis, and cross-system join validation across 100+ source tables and millions of operational and financial records, enhancing data governance and integration.

Created a phased analytical maturity roadmap adopted as the basis for anomaly detection, construction analytics, and AI-enabled decision support initiatives, driving enterprise AI architecture and governance.

Built a governed analytics assistant leveraging Gemini, BigQuery, and tool-calling architectures to enforce analyst rules and operational controls, ensuring predictable, auditable execution aligned with AI governance principles.

Evaluated graph analytics and graph machine learning approaches using Neptune, GraphStorm, Bedrock, and LangGraph to enhance operational intelligence and AI architecture.
Authored architecture and analytical readiness assessments identifying data and operational gaps impacting long-term digital twin and AI governance objectives.

Mentored students on AI architecture, governance, implementation tradeoffs, and strategies for enterprise AI adoption, strengthening technical leadership and communication skills.

professional_experience.heading: AI Instructor

Partnered with CTO-level leadership to define enterprise monitoring strategy, operational health metrics, and reliability-improvement initiatives.
Awarded the Capital One Business Innovation Award for contributions to operational intelligence and enterprise monitoring transformation; presented work at internal and external industry conferences.
